main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of 10-bar excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 and positive-60d slope > other slope; reject if t <= -2

supporting_check.name: slope on positive-60d cases minus slope on other cases

decided_by: The main slope's t is 2 or more but the supporting check failed (positive-60-day slope not larger), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are grid bars 0,10,20,... of each window with close[t+10] inside the window, the coin's mean 10-bar return is the mean over that coin's grid cases in all windows, the slope t is the ordinary OLS t (with intercept), the 'other' group is cases with a 60-day return <= 0, the 30-case minimum is counted on all cases of each group, and minimum counts not reached give 'not observable'.
